recognize_zh: 四顆小至中型淋巴細胞，核染色質中度凝集、核形略不規則或有切迹，胞質少量淡藍，特徵是胞質內散在數個清楚、邊界銳利的小空泡（A–D），這種不連續空泡是提示被套細胞淋巴瘤的細微線索。
features: Small to medium lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly irregular or notched nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant pale blue cytoplasm containing several discrete, sharply punched-out clear vacuoles
Vacuoles located at the cytoplasmic rim, sometimes indenting the nuclear outline (panel D)
Panel B: slightly larger cell with irregular cytoplasmic borders; unremarkable background red cells
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear panels (A-D) show small to medium-sized atypical lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular, notched nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and a scant rim of pale blue cytoplasm. Each cell contains a few discrete, well-circumscribed clear cytoplasmic vacuoles. The vacuoles are distinct rather than diffuse foamy change, and no large nucleoli or blastic chromatin are present. In the setting of a CD5-positive B-cell population, this morphology is suggestive of leukemic mantle cell lymphoma, which should be confirmed with cyclin D1/SOX11 or t(11;14).

ddx.vs: Cells have round nuclei with soccer-ball chromatin and usually lack discrete cytoplasmic vacuoles; CD23 is bright and cyclin D1 negative.
Cells are larger with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, fine chromatin, nucleoli and numerous vacuoles, and are CD10+/MYC-rearranged.

ddx.dx: Lysosomal storage disease or drug-induced vacuolated lymphocytes
ddx.vs: Vacuoles are seen in morphologically normal lymphocytes of a polyclonal population without a CD5+ light-chain-restricted clone.
Cells show deep narrow nuclear clefts without cytoplasmic vacuoles and are CD10+/CD5-negative.
